title: Russian: 300 Most Common Words

sources.name: Original educational writing from general knowledge

description: For beginners: 300 common Russian words and a few fixed expressions, with English meanings, transliteration, and examples. This is a curated selection rather than an exact frequency ranking; transliteration does not mark stress.

cards.example: Я дома. = I am at home.
Ты здесь? = Are you here?
Он читает. = He is reading.
Она работает. = She is working.
Оно открыто. = It is open.
Мы вместе. = We are together.

cards.back: menya — me; genitive or accusative of я
